Football returns to the Trentham Foods Stadium tonight as we welcome @SandbachFC_1st for our first home league game of the 2026/27 season.

#UpTheFoley | #NWCFL | #Since1947 https://t.co/CJPmCNQ4GU
Back the ramblers this evening as they travel to @foley_fc in search of back to back wins and that perfect start to the season. https://t.co/sLiMLf7wAx

A brace for @JoeBev97 in the last game confirmed him as @SandbachUtd highest ever scorer, surpassing @James_Kirby10 previous on 54 goals. With a whole season ahead how many can he get!
Congratulations Joe on the fantastic achievement in just two seasons at the ramblers. https://t.co/B5elk2v3Xj
